name: Stripe
notes: Stripe versions its API. Changes here are to the latest version; clients pinned to an older version are not affected until they upgrade.

name: GitHub
notes: GitHub versions its REST API by date. This file tracks the latest version, so a new dated version shows up here as changes.

name: OpenAI
notes: The spec was removed from this file in June 2025 and restored in May 2026. Months in between have no data.

name: Twilio
notes: Core REST API (2010-04-01). Twilio's other products have separate spec files.

name: Plaid
notes: Plaid versions its API by date; this is the 2020-09-14 version, which Plaid keeps updating.

name: Box
notes: Compiled spec at the repo root, published since September 2023.

name: Datadog
notes: Datadog API v2, from the spec its Go client is generated from. v1 endpoints are in a separate file.

name: Sentry
notes: Generated from Sentry's code and covers the endpoints Sentry documents publicly. oasdiff counts newly required auth scopes as breaking, which accounts for some of the busiest months.

name: Okta
notes: Management API. Okta has published the current spec at this path since June 2024. The November 2025 version had duplicate keys and could not be read, so August 2025 to March 2026 is one gap.
